scientific_integrity: Proof of all-prime cardinality uses the established Chebotarev Fourier-minor and Caratheodory theorems; the eleven-point orbit census is established by an attached exact rational-interval computation. Self-reviewed, no independent audit.

title: Seven-frequency positive Fourier designs on prime cycles: the three eleven-point optimizer orbits
